title: Open Agents — build board
description: Work in flight on dennisonbertram/fork-open-agents. Cards are real GitHub PRs, real GitHub issues, or named local work. Nothing here is a projection or a target. A card in Shipped means the change is merged to main and the commit is deployed to production.
headerNote: Snapshot: 2026-08-17 20:00. Production is live on ae40a224 and healthy — verified against the GitHub deployment record, which points at the running Vercel deployment. develop is 4 commits ahead of main and ready for the next release. GitHub recovered at 19:03 after a 5-hour partial outage.

columnDescriptions.Backlog: Filed and not started. Open issues and unmerged older PRs.
columnDescriptions.In progress: Being worked now, no PR open yet.
columnDescriptions.In review: PR open. Waiting on CI, review, or a merge train slot.
columnDescriptions.Shipped: Merged to main and live in production. A change sitting on develop does not belong here, however finished it is.

cards.note: Merged and released to main in ae40a224. The fix had sat finished on an unopened branch, so production readiness reported green for a repo the dispatcher refuses. 7 readiness tests, 753 pass across the background-agents suite.

cards.title: Make run lists triageable
cards.note: PR #1334 merged to develop, awaiting the next release. Attention reasons render, a status tab no longer counts as a filter, and a reason that only repeats the outcome is hidden — that last one came from looking at the rendered page, where a failed run showed Finished, Failed, Needs attention, Failed. A source-text guard broke when the copy moved file; CI caught it.

cards.note: Committed in #1335, which is merged to develop but not yet released, so it is not in production. Verdict is not to adopt the registry: none of the run-list defects it was measured against needs a new component, and the library does not state its framework anywhere.

cards.title: Release train, round one
cards.note: Complete. #1329 merged as ae40a224, carrying #1330, #1332 and #1333, and it is live in production and healthy. Its own CI failed twice on GitHub returning 429 for an action download and went green on the third run. The backmerge (#1337) followed immediately.

cards.title: Release deployed; the status tools said otherwise
cards.note: Resolved, and the original diagnosis was wrong. Vercel did build ae40a224 at 17:18. The outage stopped it reporting that back to GitHub, so the commit carried no Vercel check and ops:status fell back to a stale deployment record showing the previous SHA. The GitHub deployment record posted at 16:17 UTC points at the running deployment and confirms ae40a224 is live. A manual CLI deploy started on the wrong diagnosis was redundant and never completed.

cards.title: Remote work continues on a Hetzner VM
cards.note: Two jobs, both delivered and both merged to develop but not yet released: the story catalog (#1336) and the flow critique (#1338). Each ran under systemd on its own VM with its own branch and pull request, and kept working while the laptop was closed. The base image has node, git and gh but no Bun, so only toolchain-free work goes there. Both VMs are deleted.

cards.title: Actions and Secrets check the App's permission, not the user's
cards.note: Found by the flow critique and confirmed by reading the code: apps/web/lib/github/actions-manager/readiness.ts decides canWrite from the GitHub App installation's permissions and contains no verifyRepoAccess, no requiredUserPermission and no userId. A read-only collaborator sees an enabled Run workflow button and an enabled Add secret form, and only finds out at submit time. Same defect class as the background-agent readiness bug fixed today in #1332. No issue filed yet.

cards.title: ops:status can print a SHA that is not the deployment's
cards.note: scripts/ops-status.ts takes the deployment identity from Vercel but the SHA from Vercel's meta.githubCommitSha, falling back to the latest GitHub deployment record when that is absent. The two can describe different deployments and the output gives no sign of it. Today it reported the previous SHA beside a deployment running the new one, for two hours, during an incident. No issue filed yet.

cards.title: Hot-path DB indexes and event retention job
cards.note: Issue #1400 implemented on cursor/feat-1400-db-indexes-retention-b536. Indexes + 0095_rapid_quasimodo migration; retention.ts wired into background-agents cron. Push only — no PR per task.

cards.title: Unblock the cloud UX walk — safe test-auth + bootstrap
cards.note: PR #1390 implements epic #1389 slices 1–4. Slices 5–6 (Dev env flip + STORY-158 cloud proof) stay operator-blocked.

cards.title: Release train, round two
cards.note: Not started, and nothing blocks it now that GitHub is back. Four commits wait on develop: #1334 runs triage, #1335 kanban board, #1336 story catalog, #1337 backmerge. #1338 (flow critique) is open and could ride along if merged first. Needs a release PR from develop to main, then a backmerge.
